description.text: The fifth Diamond & Pearl set, released in May 2008 with 100 cards, the smallest of the series, and two theme decks, Forest Force and Polar Frost. Eevee's two new evolutions, Leafeon and Glaceon, made their debut, which put all seven of its evolutions in the set, and Garchomp LV.X leads its four Pokémon LV.X. Its Fossils are Dome Fossil, Helix Fossil and Old Amber, and its cards came from a mix of Japanese releases, among them promos and the Japanese cards Great Encounters left out.
